stories.headline: SpaceX caught an orbital Starship upper stage with Mechazilla on Flight 15
stories.quote: Over the weekend on Starship Flight 15, Ship 42 launched from Starbase, Texas, reached orbit, deployed a batch of Starlink satellites, spent more than 22 hours in space, survived fiery hypersonic re-entry, flipped upright, and dropped cleanly into Mechazilla’s chopsticks.

facts.text: The author's estimate of marginal launch cost with a reusable upper stage.
facts.quote: making it reusable means that the marginal cost of launch drops to something like $2-10M per launch, or $20-100/kg versus Falcon 9’s $1,000/kg internal cost
the goal is to send up about two a week by the end of 2027, hundreds per year by 2029 ,and multiple per day beyond that

stories.headline: SELLAS and Memorial Sloan Kettering report positive Phase 3 results for leukemia vaccine GPS
stories.quote: On Tuesday, SELLAS Life Sciences and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center announced positive topline results from the pivotal Phase 3 REGAL trial of galinpepimut-S (GPS), an immunotherapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
stories.description: Immunotherapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia

facts.text: Median overall survival 24.0 months on GPS alone against 14.7 months on best available treatment.
facts.quote: Patients who received GPS alone (with no chemo alongside it) had a median overall survival of 24.0 months, compared to 14.7 months for patients on investigator's choice of best available treatment.

facts.text: 41% reduction in the risk of death; 126 patients in the trial.
facts.quote: That's more than nine extra months of life and a 41% reduction in the risk of death.

stories.headline: BBC reports a pancreatic cancer pill trial in which some tumours became undetectable
stories.quote: there’s a new pill for pancreatic cancer that shrunk tumors in one in 12 patients so completely they were undetectable in scans, and stopped tumor growth in 90% of the 61 patients

stories.headline: Palmer Luckey announces SLAB, a seastead with a 1,000-year design life
stories.quote: Luckey announced on X (to preempt a journalist working on the story) that he’s “developing a seastead called SLAB with a 1,000 year design life.”
stories.description: Offshore floating industrial platform with a 1,000-year design life

stories.headline: Earth AI says its Alpheus model found a 3km copper, gold and platinum-group metals system in New South Wales
stories.quote: This week, the company announced that its Alpheus AI model found a continuous copper, gold, and platinum-group metals system stretching more than 3 kilometers at the Fontenoy/Meridian project in New South Wales, Australia.
stories.description: Uses AI models and its own rigs to find metals

facts.quote: It’s drilled 35 holes and traced mineralization from 30m to 478m deep across the 3km seam, with hints that it might actually be 8km long.

facts.text: Earth AI is a not boring capital portfolio company (author's disclosure).
facts.quote: our friends and not boring capital portfolio company Earth AI are using it to find metals
